test.create_query: CREATE TABLE hashed_keys_r ( k1 UInt64, k2 UInt64, k3 UInt64, k4 UInt64, k5 UInt64, s40 String, u UInt64, s15 String, ns Nullable(String), v UInt64 ) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE hashed_keys_l ( k1 UInt64, k2 UInt64, k3 UInt64, k4 UInt64, k5 UInt64, s40 String, u UInt64, s15 String, ns Nullable(String), v UInt64 ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO hashed_keys_r SELECT number AS x, x * 3, x * 5, x * 7, x * 11, rightPad(concat(toString(x), '_'), 16 + intHash32(x) % 25, 'k') AS s, x * 13, substring(hex(intHash64(x)), 1, intHash32(x * 7 + 1) % 16), if(x = 0, NULL, toNullable(s)), x FROM numbers_mt(10000000)

INSERT INTO hashed_keys_l SELECT (number * 2654435761) % 20000000 AS x, x * 3, x * 5, x * 7, x * 11, rightPad(concat(toString(x), '_'), 16 + intHash32(x) % 25, 'k') AS s, x * 13, substring(hex(intHash64(x)), 1, intHash32(x * 7 + 1) % 16), if(x = 0 OR x % 100 = 1, NULL, toNullable(s)), x FROM numbers_mt(20000000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE hashed_keys_long_r (u UInt64, s String, v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE hashed_keys_long_l (u UInt64, s String, v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE hashed_keys_very_long_r (u UInt64, s String, v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE hashed_keys_very_long_l (u UInt64, s String, v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO hashed_keys_long_r SELECT number AS x, substring(repeat(hex(intHash64(x)), 200), 1, 1024 + intHash32(x) % 2048), x FROM numbers_mt(100000)
INSERT INTO hashed_keys_long_l SELECT (number * 2654435761) % 200000 AS x, substring(repeat(hex(intHash64(x)), 200), 1, 1024 + intHash32(x) % 2048), x FROM numbers_mt(200000)
INSERT INTO hashed_keys_very_long_r SELECT number AS x, substring(repeat(hex(intHash64(x)), 1100), 1, 8192 + intHash32(x) % 8192), x FROM numbers_mt(20000)
INSERT INTO hashed_keys_very_long_l SELECT (number * 2654435761) % 40000 AS x, substring(repeat(hex(intHash64(x)), 1100), 1, 8192 + intHash32(x) % 8192), x FROM numbers_mt(40000)
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(r.v) FROM hashed_keys_l AS l INNER JOIN hashed_keys_r AS r ON l.k1 = r.k1 AND l.k2 = r.k2 AND l.k3 = r.k3 AND l.k4 = r.k4 AND l.k5 = r.k5
SELECT count(), sum(r.v) FROM hashed_keys_l AS l INNER JOIN hashed_keys_r AS r ON l.s40 = r.s40 AND l.u = r.u
SELECT count(), sum(r.v) FROM hashed_keys_l AS l INNER JOIN hashed_keys_r AS r ON l.s15 = r.s15 AND l.u = r.u
SELECT count(), sum(r.v) FROM hashed_keys_l AS l INNER JOIN hashed_keys_r AS r ON l.ns <=> r.ns
SELECT count(), sum(r.v) FROM hashed_keys_l AS l LEFT ANY JOIN hashed_keys_r AS r ON l.s40 = r.s40 AND l.u = r.u

SELECT count(), sum(r.v) FROM hashed_keys_l AS l INNER JOIN hashed_keys_r AS r ON (l.s40 = r.s40 AND l.u = r.u) OR (l.k1 = r.k1 AND l.k2 = r.k2 AND l.k3 = r.k3 AND l.k4 = r.k4 AND l.k5 = r.k5) SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash'
SELECT count(), sum(r.v) FROM hashed_keys_long_l AS l INNER JOIN hashed_keys_long_r AS r ON l.s = r.s AND l.u = r.u
SELECT count(), sum(r.v) FROM hashed_keys_very_long_l AS l INNER JOIN hashed_keys_very_long_r AS r ON l.s = r.s AND l.u = r.u
